scope: AG05 native contact provenance, current ASR revision, conditional persistence and read projection

independent_postgresql.scope: Disposable database, actual SQL and API projections; synthetic provider events, no live calls or external deliveries.

limitations: These are deterministic offline/runtime and disposable-database checks, not a live acoustic or model quality qualification.
A correlated transport-played receipt is transport evidence, not proof that a person heard or understood the readback.
Traditional contact confirmation currently has no correlated readback receipt identifier; no identifier is invented.
Legacy caller contacts without typed provenance remain explicitly unversioned; they are not retroactively verified.
Current-item source revision handling is bounded; it does not implement general historical contact replay.

Persistent database outage or process death cannot recover evidence that was never committed. Durable transcript state and source projection prevent a known changed source from appearing currently confirmed.
Previously frozen CRM delivery payloads are not reconciled by this change; that remains the explicit AG06 handoff. New summary reads use the shared contact projection.
